status: Dictionary-first assignment declarations; no case grades

declarations.rationale: Destination movement dominates: leave-for, return-to, move-to and relocation; other presence/meeting/sports paths do not expand movement scope.
Explicit economist affiliation dominates the complete dictionary; analyst, principal and other jobs remain distinct.
Owner, ownership and completed acquisition establish X owner of Y; merger, watching or managerial titles alone do not.
Organizational unit/part/subsidiary of parent dominates; preserve direction and require organizational first argument.
Live-in paths overwhelmingly dominate. Travel, entry, flight and mere presence remain distinct.
Corporate descriptions modified by national affiliation dominate. This is nationality description, not geographic headquarters inferred from nationality.
Explicit coach office and coaching dominate; generic team possession and management do not become coaching.
Editorial office/editing is the dominant family; publisher, writer and founder are deliberately outside editor scope.
Inverse political-office paths: country/body first, its president/leader/dictator second. Meetings with politicians alone are insufficient.
Owned-by and unit/division-of dominate the child-to-parent direction.
Membership, join, entry, admission and expulsion from organized bodies dominate; literal organizations and temporal actuality must be checked per fact.
Parent/owner and owns/acquisition paths dominate the owner-to-owned direction.
Inverse spokesperson paths dominate: principal first and spokesperson second. Bare location of speech is not itself the office.
Review of artistic work/performance is the consistent dictionary family; destination venue alone may be ambiguous and is not automatically the performer.
Ask/notify/report/tell establish directed communication. Frequent bare send-to requires object/role evidence and cannot imply all sending is communication.
Head, president and chairman jointly dominate explicit organizational leadership; founding/legal service alone remains distinct.
Attorney/lawyer affiliation clearly dominates; generic coordinator or representative is not automatically legal counsel.
Meeting/encounter paths are the strongest coherent family. Saying something about, telephoning or writing alone does not establish an actual meeting.

Literal first arguments are mainly New York/San Francisco/Chicago and second arguments advertising organizations: office/unit paths identify a geographic host of an organizational office. Preserve inverse location, not city-as-subsidiary. Genuine subsidiary facts in the minority do not broaden this predicate.
President office dominates; manager, chair, owner and broad leader paths do not widen this title-specific predicate.
Explicit presidency dominates; candidacy, nomination and proposals remain nonactual or ambiguous rather than establishing tenure.
Organization based/in-place and headquarters descriptions dominate; location of a board meeting alone need not locate the organization.
Based-in and campus/headquarters location dominate; manufacture alone does not establish headquarters.
Winner/win and award/competition receipt dominate. Scope includes named nonsport awards as well as competitions; participation alone is insufficient.
Professor/teach paths dominate; dean, scientist, expert and analyst alone retain distinct roles.

Central scope adjudication retains residence as the meaningful local interpretation of the obituary/relative-to-Manhattan cluster. Direct live-in evidence exists; son/brother-of ending at a place is an omitted-relative attachment and cannot establish either kinship to a city or automatic residence of X. Such unsupported attachments retain specific ambiguity questions.
Based/headquarters location dominates the organization-to-place direction.
Firm appositions/dependency locations plus explicit based-in dominate; literal entity roles distinguish location from organizational affiliation.
Accusation/criticism is the largest coherent family. Voting with or joining a party does not establish criticism.

After ordered-role inspection, sporting teams in/winning/losing World Series and league races form the largest interpretable domain; participation accommodates explicit competed-and-lost paths without imposing victory. Mixed White House political-office and physical-presence uses are separate and not absorbed.
Leader/whip/chair office dominates; party adjective must identify a body, and candidate/fundraising alone does not establish leadership.

Join/cooperation is the largest candidate family (join 8, ally/sign 2) in country/party pairs. Central reviewer approved the narrow joint-action predicate, retaining A for generic join without shared action and E for adversarial war or mere relations.

Destination movement family (return/bring/move/travel-to, 14 rows) narrowly exceeds departure family (leave/move-from, 13). Preserve the explicit destination direction and note genuine mixed movement dictionary.
Inverse leader/whip paths dominate party/body first and officeholder second; aides/supporters and candidate attachments remain distinct.
Explicit chairman title dominates, including prior office shown by retirement/replacement; generic center possession does not establish chairmanship.
Writing/review/critic work for a publication is the largest coherent family; mere quotation in a publication is not automatically authorship.
Tell is the dominant individual and coherent communication family; working with, marriage, alliance and support remain separate.
Owned-by, subsidiary/unit-of and own parent dominate the child-to-parent direction; proposed offers alone do not establish ownership.

Mixed explicit director/president/head offices form the largest leadership-office family (17 rows) compared with economist descriptions (13); economist alone remains outside this declared managerial scope. This breadth is explicit, not a post-grade expansion.
Spokesman/spokeswoman and speaking for a principal dominate; communications job titles alone need their existing scope treatment.
Executive office is the strongest explicit title family; chief/head/chair alone is not silently broadened into executive.
Urge supplies an unambiguous directed-communication family. Equally frequent submit-to has omitted object and requires the frozen communications ambiguity rule.
Arrival/come/leave-for destination movement dominates. Speech or presence in a place alone is separate; summons and preparations retain actuality caveats.
Chairman title dominates over founder or executive; explicit retirement from chair also establishes historical office.
Inverse wife paths dominate and ordered pairs consistently identify X with named wife Y; daughter/mother/adviser/roommate remain distinct relationships.
Firm/company-in-place and headquarters paths dominate; nationality adjectives alone do not establish exact geographic base.
Tell/ask/speak/message is the largest coherent family; bare give and attorney-mediated call require attachment/object checks.
Urge/tell/speak/suggest/report dominates communication to an addressee. Say-of or speaking against a comment need not address its subject.
Died/killed/death-in is the dominant coherent predicate; killer-subject, mere residence, and event rather than geographic destination retain separate treatment.
Persuade explicitly supplies communication to Y; frequent send variants have omitted objects and follow the existing ambiguity convention.
Explicit manager office overwhelmingly dominates; presidency, generic leadership or travel with a team is not expanded into manager.
Attorney office and legal service for a jurisdiction dominate; nomination/support/confirmation alone must establish actual tenure rather than proposed service.
Inverse country-to-minister/leader descriptions form the strongest coherent office family; mere saying in a place or policy comments are insufficient.
Ordered-role inspection identifies mainly political groups/teams including named people; select inverse membership, not general containment of people, places and relatives in one catchall.
Know/refer-as dominates explicit alternative naming of the same entity; attachment and distinct counterpart identity remain case questions.
Country/national group first and its president or government leader second dominate. Incomplete adjectival national identity retains the previous ambiguity rule.
Professor/teach family dominates the explicit academic office; expert/specialist/scientist alone does not establish teaching.
Inverse political leader paths dominate country/body-to-officeholder direction; plain speaking in the body or an aide attachment remains insufficient.
Founding/founder dominates. Leadership, ownership or a later chair office alone is a distinct predicate.
Chief/chair/leader dominates explicit organizational leadership; director-only descriptions do not silently widen the existing scope.
District/United States attorney titles and ordered jurisdiction arguments identify public legal service; mere accountant or private lawyer location is distinct.

After role inspection, basketball/hockey athlete-to-team facts dominate center and sports-performance paths; political organizational leading is a separate minority. Lead alone can denote a coach and is not automatic athlete evidence.
Explicit membership and participating votes/veto inside a named body dominate. Alliance, addressing a session and work on a resolution require the existing membership evidence rule.
Birth/native paths are the largest coherent family; childhood/residence and geographic ties alone remain distinct.
Lawyer descriptors with geographic first-name-to-city pairs denote professional location, not attorney representation of the city. Co-op/tax descriptors alone remain insufficient.

Teams paired with Stanley Cup/World Series/Super Bowl dominate; led-to, faced/lost-in and team/event contexts establish participation when actual. This is not necessarily championship victory. City-base pairs are separate.

Mixed director/head/executive office paths (9 rows) form the largest explicit office family, exceeding spokesperson and advisor subfamilies (7 each). Scope breadth is declared now; adviser/spokesperson alone do not become managerial office.
Leave/emigrate/influx-from forms the largest movement-origin family, ahead of coaching. White House/employer departure may be figurative; no automatic physical movement or tenure inference.

Ordered arguments are Nets/Spurs first and Byron Scott/Gregg Popovich/Lawrence Frank second. Possessive coach supports inverse coaching; malformed coach/say chains keep their attachment ambiguity rather than reversing the predicate.
Chairman is the dominant title. Nomination and indirect person attachments retain actuality and argument-role restrictions.
Leader/co-chairman is the strongest explicit office family; candidacy, protégé and executive-only paths are not automatically leadership.
Owner/own/co-own and property ownership dominates; developer, publisher and presiding over alone do not establish possession.
Acquiring/retaining/losing political control is the dominant family; election of a person or committee membership remains distinct.
Trips/visits/come/fly to geographic destination dominate; senator-from and office location alone do not establish travel.
Departure/withdrawal from a place clearly dominates; invasion/occupation and lobbying for a country do not imply departure.
Move/emigrate/resettle/relocate to a destination dominates; origin, mere residence and organizational base retain their direction/type limits.

Spokesperson/speech-at-office is the clearest identified directional family, amid opaque Bell-company descriptions and business ventures. Select principal-to-spokesperson without inventing a generic Bell affiliation predicate; bare saying at an office still needs role evidence.

Ordered-role inspection identifies nine accession/admission/entry rows for Poland→EU and China→WTO, the strongest coherent institutional family, versus seven travel/entry rows to physical or office destinations. Select membership rather than conflate institutional accession and physical movement; go alone remains insufficient.
Mixed explicit director/president/chair/head offices form the dominant office family; analyst work and physical place/address evidence remain outside managerial scope.
County/jurisdiction executive title dominates; candidate/elect/run-for rows require actual-tenure checks under the existing executive predicate.
Born-in paths overwhelmingly dominate; citizenship and study elsewhere do not establish birthplace.
Explicit chairman office dominates; ownership or generic responsibility alone remains outside the title scope.
Replacement/succession of a named person is the dominant family; choosing/removing someone or an omitted taken object does not by itself establish succeeding that person.

Independent central review found no defensible dominant semantic family: underspecified take/give/carry spans coach-player, athlete-team, opponents, territorial capture and movie-title relations. Retain all six facts as semantic-indeterminacy ambiguities, not excluded observations.
Living/expatriate-in is the strongest clear family, with national/population labels. Tourist/diplomatic/business location and nationality adjectives require their existing type/identity distinctions.

Death at home in geographic Y is the dominant individual and coherent path; home ownership/residence may be implied there but the primary event is death. Relative and institutional paths do not establish X death.
Lead/chair/head office family (12 rows) exceeds generic sit/be on membership (8). Membership and sponsoring a bill are not enough for the declared office.
President title dominates; partner, analyst, officer and specialist alone remain separate.
Director office dominates the mixed leadership dictionary; merely run/head/president does not acquire a director title.
Ordered roles show party-to-House/Senate control/winning as the strongest coherent cluster, amid unrelated birth/occupation paths. Retain political body and actuality limits.
Directed testimony/address/advice is the consistent family; an omitted committee member or testimony subject can still create attachment ambiguity.
Director/co-director paths dominate; academic expertise, chairman and generic overseeing remain distinct.
Explicit director office is the strongest single role family; aide/adviser/staff membership alone is not the same office.

At-place and event/venue/address descriptions dominate physical presence/location; this mixed dictionary does not imply every entity is headquartered at the venue. Temporal scheduled appearances retain their actuality caveat.
Being driven out/from and completed withdrawal (8 rows) is the largest identifiable directional family, exceeding invasion (5). Geographic population and invasion alone do not imply departure.
Accuse/blame/assail/attack family exceeds warnings; warning or reaction to an ultimatum alone does not prove criticism of Y.
Explicit champion/retained/held/defended title dominates. Challenger participation or merely fighting for the title is not victory.
Analyst affiliation dominates; publisher/editor/director/partner and company location are separate unless actual analyst support is present.

Dictionary and roles mix organizational subsidiaries, NATO membership and city offices. Two organization-parent facts supply eight explicit part/unit rows, tying eight NATO membership/ally rows; the strongest individually interpretable repeated path family is part-of. Select subsidiary scope before grading; alliances and city-as-unit are not absorbed.
Go/come/immigration/visit to a destination dominates; residence or acting in a production is not itself geographic travel.
Inverse secretary/spokesman-and-speech family is the strongest interpretable role; generic successor descriptions do not make Y spokesperson for X.
Party→White House/Congress/House take/control paths dominate the identifiable political-control family; politician association or closeness to Bush remains outside it.

Call-on a legislature is the clearest directed-appeal family. More frequent push-through omits the pushed object and follows the existing communication ambiguity rule; gaining control is a separate predicate.
Headquarters location dominates; nearby town and founding-garage attachment need the existing geographic scope checks.
Return/emigrate-to is the largest identifiable family, amid political support, office and territorial ownership; retain explicit destination direction.
Secretary/spokesman/face-of descriptions identify a public spokesperson context. Plain secretary title still needs the frozen press-office context rule.
Known-as/by-acronym naming overwhelmingly dominates; violence/trial locations and omitted nominal arguments remain separate.
Every ordered pair is a team and stadium; actual game/play/win/lose-at dominates. Freeze sport participation at a venue rather than count every physical visit or plan as playing.
Explicit won/retained title/championship family dominates World Boxing Council and World Series facts; athlete/team membership and participation alone remain insufficient.
Ordered roles identify research/publishing organizations in Chicago/Armonk, with explicit based-in support; lawyer-client hiring facts remain a distinct minority.
Inverse minister/government leadership is the strongest coherent family; visiting/letter subjects with omitted attachments remain restricted.
Spokeswoman and press-secretary contexts dominate; aide, closeness and director roles alone do not establish spokesperson service.
Played/lost/won-in competition family dominates, so participation is primary and neither loss nor mere title reference becomes a required victory.
Controlled-by is the largest identifiable family, with government/body first and controlling party second; member/leader and trade are distinct.
Explicit official/job/post affiliation dominates, distinct from a specified managerial office. This does not infer leadership from bare official status or turn a city into a person.
Office/agency part-of-parent paths dominate and the principal literal pairs are organizations. Sports shock and inverse political office are distinct minorities.
Inverse president paths dominate, with Senate/borough public body first and person second. Election/proposals and indirect letter arguments retain existing scope limits.
Director title and tenure/sworn/replaced/resigned descriptions overwhelmingly dominate; generic serve-at alone does not suffice.

Say-of/comment/remark/regarding is a coherent eight-row topic family amid a similarly sized player-selection family. The tie favors say-of (five occurrences), the highest-frequency interpretable individual path, without inferring a coach title from remove/play.
Explicit champion and led-to-victory is the strongest title family; performance, preparation or record-breaking alone is not championship tenure.
Founder/found/establish dominates; lead/president/director alone remains distinct.
Beat/defeat overwhelmingly dominates completed victory; playing/facing/fighting alone does not establish outcome.
Player center/scorer and scored-goals-for team dominate; bare giving or awards do not alone establish athletic team membership.

Independent central adjudication found a genuine unresolved tie: residence two paths versus sports/performance two, while the only repeated path (two) has uncertain spokeswoman/charges argument roles. No stable dominant predicate can be fixed without selecting a favored case; retain all four as A.
Institutional headquarters/galleries/salesrooms/houses in place dominate; a sale event location alone is not necessarily the base.

Attack/criticize/go-after/case-against (six rows) ties acquired/owned-by family (six). The prescribed individual-path tie break favors repeated attack/criticize (two each), so criticism is frozen rather than combining business ownership and political opposition.
Unit/subsidiary/owned-company description dominates; organizational child-to-parent roles fixed.

Chief office is the only repeated coherent role family (three chief paths) amid assorted political comparison/support topics. Preserve this weak dictionary support explicitly; political topic mentions do not become leadership and bureau attachment remains relevant.
Review of film/collection/release dominates artistic criticism. Business units and bare team-without are unrelated; distinguish artist from reviewed work/venue.
Division/unit/part plus sold-to-parent dominates child-to-parent ownership; possessive unit in the opposite direction stays separate.
Director office is the strongest specific title family; include/partner/president descriptions alone do not establish directorship.

Presidential-office/presiding family is the strongest interpretable title family in an otherwise heterogeneous dictionary, slightly ahead of departure/resettlement. Omitted president attachments and generic meeting presidency retain ambiguity.

Ordered-role inspection shows Eagles→Giants sporting encounter in four play/game rows, the largest interpretable narrow family; opaque Internet company descriptors and corporate founding/location remain separate.
Nine team→opponent rows of visiting/playing/trailing/triumph form the largest coherent family; geographic visiting by people and parent-company links are not competitive encounters.
Mixed explicit leader/chair/speaker/executive offices jointly dominate, so the existing declared managerial family applies. Winning-in and troop withdrawals do not imply an office.
Inverse counsel/lawyer and defended-by family dominates: client X has lawyer Y; generic keeping/emphasis does not prove legal service.
Explicit official and departmental roles dominate public institutional affiliation. Bare candidate-for-job and unrelated borough/home location remain insufficient.
Explicit support plus vote-for (five rows) is the strongest clear family; pressuring Y and generic giving alone do not establish political/material support.
Visit/travel to geographic destination is the strongest coherent family. Stores/research or meetings in a place alone do not necessarily prove movement.

Physical at-place/address evidence is the largest coherent spatial family after role inspection (museum→street and personal presence). Director-office paths form a competing distinct family; neither role alone locates the person physically.
Literal first arguments House/Senate and second political parties fix inverse political control; generic have/hold rows require the existing body-control convention.

Spatial living/being/beginning-in descriptions for Motorola→Schaumburg and God→heaven dominate the mixed dictionary; disease paths are separate. Metaphorical/religious location retains explicit actuality/type ambiguity.
Head/leading a body is the largest explicit family; spokesperson/diplomat/envoy and generic director-only descriptions remain distinct or ambiguous under the existing scope.
Death/killed-in geographic place is the strongest coherent event family; weapons sale, residence, exile or hospitalization alone do not prove death.
Have/suffer/infected/die-of condition dominates; condition/exposure and population-subset ambiguity remain explicit.
President/run/chair roles form the dominant organizational leadership family; owner and producer alone remain separate.

Central independent full-row review finds geographic dateline-to-agency fragments; these do not establish geographic offices or person-to-institution official relations. No sound primary proposition is recoverable, so preserve three semantic-indeterminacy ambiguities.

Explicit membership/colleague/serve-on and departure from membership is the largest coherent family; chair-only roles must meet the existing member evidence scope and ordinary hosted visits are distinct.
Spokesman family has the highest coherent support; alliance, directorship and research are separate.
Named winner/victory/tournament family dominates, including event winners beyond generic spokesman descriptions. Being swept or favorite alone does not prove victory.
Whip and leadership office, including resignation/deposition from office, dominates; response/meeting/chamber activity alone does not establish title.

Central independent full-row review identifies WASHINGTON dateline fragments with paired subjects, not a defined official/organization-location proposition. Retain two unresolved facts with explicit reporting-locale/argument-role questions.
Tell/conversation/explanation family (six paths/rows) exceeds meeting-alone (three). Generic forging or founder/manager attachments remain distinct.
Complete dictionary consists of varied explicit commissioner/administrator/head/chair/president offices; use the existing broad managerial office family, with no inference from mere membership.
Winner/title/victory family dominates a mixed sports and political dictionary; runner-up/participation alone is not winning the competition.
Inverse lawyer/attorney descriptions dominate; transactional owner/bid/seller relations remain separate.
Named wife as second argument dominates accompaniment/arrival and relationship paths. Issue-with alone cannot prove marriage.
Specialized legal expertise in the First Amendment is the largest coherent family; Council of Economic Advisers membership is a separate minority. Client service is not inferred from a legal subject.
Co-founder is the highest-frequency interpretable individual path and the strongest identifiable single proposition; birth and counsel attachments remain separate.

Washington first, consumer/civil-liberties organizations second: office/director/analyst-in-city paths indicate inverse organizational office location. Geopolitical severing-relations is a separate minority; individual presence alone needs the existing office criterion.
Chairman title/reappointment/resignation is the dominant family; fraud, sports coaching and generic contribution remain distinct.
Trailing opponent has eight rows versus sweep/victory seven, so intermediate score/standings lag is the dominant primary predicate; being swept does not itself prove a specified trailing snapshot.
Explicit leader/speaker/head offices dominate; introducing a bill or floor movement alone does not establish leadership.
The largest literal-role family concerns holding/bringing/bidding for Olympics in New York. Select actual event at a place, preserving A for bids/plans; Yankees geographic relocation is separate.
Director-for title is the strongest coherent role; front-runner, speech-for, and generic compilation/essay authorship do not establish directorship.

CBS→Super Bowl broadcasting/telecast/right-to-broadcast is the strongest coherent event family. Rights and after-event broadcasts retain the centrally fixed nonactual/wrong-object limits; political support is separate.
Outnumber is the dominant repeated predicate for political group sizes; national corporate descriptors and office location are unrelated.
Comment/words/view/talk-about is the largest identifiable topic family amid business units and political/managerial activity. Opposition or a view must actually concern Y, not merely coexist.
Inverse president/commander/leader family dominates Taiwan/Yugoslav-to-person facts; first-name-to-Manhattan location/relative evidence is separate.
Explicit executive title dominates; partner/president alone is distinct under the frozen executive predicate.
Client-to-lawyer is the largest identifiable recurring relation family, amid heterogeneous East/West and name-fragment patterns; generic estimates/partnership/hold-for do not become counsel.
Replacement/substitute/take-place family is the strongest coherent relation, with narrow same-role person succession; office appointments and institutional second arguments are not absorbed.
Birth/family-in geographic place is the strongest coherent family; political comparison, threat and viewpoint rows are unrelated. Parent location without X birth remains ambiguous.

Complete dictionary spells the program title Meet the Press with NBC/NBC News first and truncated Press second. Select network-to-program broadcast association, not person-to-person meeting; incomplete title identity requires its own check.
Inverse party/national leader and leadership-under paths dominate; challenger/nominee/opponent alone does not establish office.
Wife/widow relation is the largest coherent family and preserves historical marriage; corporate units are separate.
Explicit director title dominates; counselor/expert and speaking at an institution alone are insufficient.
Live/resident/apartment context is the strongest coherent family; writings or production revivals in a place do not establish personal residence.
Territorial capture/seizure by political forces dominates the political-control sense allowed by the frozen scope; capturing a sporting cup remains a distinct meaning.
Return/go-to destination movement is the strongest repeated family; national company/court descriptions do not establish travel.
Organizational office/unit part-of family exceeds legislative seats and generic support; keep child organization-to-parent direction.
Secretary and press-corps/spokesman descriptions form the strongest coherent public-speaking role family; known-as names and finance instruments are separate.
Explicit director office overwhelmingly dominates; planner or incoming population alone remains distinct.
Send/contact/suggestion/testimony is the strongest coherent communication family; omitted sending objects and ambassador/foreign-policy attachments keep their ambiguity.

Military attack/on in United States→Iraq is the largest coherent path family; critical writing and editorial affiliation are separate. The fixed warfare predicate includes actual military attacks without requiring territorial control.
Inverse national leader and government-led-by paths dominate; national adjective and misplaced counterpart identity retain the established ambiguity rule.
Put/keep/occupy/in-place is the largest coherent family in White House pairs; political-office metonymy is not assumed to prove physical presence. Guggenheim director titles are separate.
Inverse president/body family is the strongest coherent relation; lawyer-client and executive-to-county directions are separate.

Inverse government/minister descriptions (six paths) narrowly exceed five forward managerial titles, so body-to-political leader is primary; direction and minister-designate nonactuality are retained.

Independent central review confirms a three-way singleton-family tie: Google/Internet industry descriptions, Karadzic/BosnianSerbs leadership and Palestinian/Gaza physical conflict each roughly four rows. No interpretable highest-frequency tie-break fixes a primary meaning; retain all three A.
Economist affiliation is the largest explicit repeated role; sports guard and manager/director titles are not expanded into economics.

Independent central review confirms inverse political-office versus coaching/context tie (about four clear/contextual rows each); repeated return spans both and is role-ambiguous. Retain both facts A rather than choose one case to favor.

Constitution→Senate/Congress grant/provision/give family dominates. The instrument must actually confer a specified right or power; omitted giving object is ambiguous. Athletic contribution is separate.
Parent/company ownership family is the largest coherent relation, with Ameritech→Bell; Polish population migration/death/location paths form separate narrower relations.
Official/job affiliation dominates the mixed public-office dictionary; a specific leadership title is not required, but generic personal appearance remains insufficient.
Champion/title descriptions dominate; unspecified medalist and record holder alone do not establish a championship title.
Sell/sale-to is the clear dominant family; geographic journeys, family obituary fragments and sports counterpart pairs do not automatically establish sale.
Known-as/acronym alternative identity dominates; ratios and managerial office are distinct.

Geographic living/stationing/venues/travel form the largest spatial family across American→England and cinema→street; possessive deputy-to-organization is distinct. Retain generic nationality and future venue ambiguity.

Talks/summit between named people is the strongest identifiable narrow event family; paired-subject name fragments and teaching are unrelated. Arriving for or expecting a meeting is not automatic actual meeting.
Outlast is the dominant path, fixing competitive victory; alternative names and team management are distinct minorities.
Flee/driven-from geographic origin dominates; sovereignty/autonomy and chair nomination are separate.
Company/school/station in place and based-in dominate; national media adjectives alone do not determine a physical location.
Institution/gallery/headquarters/building location dominates; mere appearance or personal assistant location must refer to X institution itself.

Pitcher/pitch/play athletic family is the largest identifiable role, narrowly ahead of coach titles. Historical player service remains valid, but coaching alone does not make a fact an athlete relation.

Organizational unit (two identical paths) ties river-flow and athletic-role families on clear predicate occurrences; the numeric-frequency tie rule selects the repeated unit path over separate singleton flow and play/captain paths. Opaque be-subject fragments cannot settle another meaning.
Come/immigrate/follow-to family is the largest coherent movement family, amid athletic and executive roles; team presence alone does not imply geographic migration.
Named research/consultancy organizations and city arguments make organizational location the consistent family, rather than person-to-employer analyst affiliation.
Coaching/program family has seven paths versus six movement/remain paths; select coach-to-team/program, with North Korean movement a separate minority.
Inverse public minister/official family is the strongest coherent relation, exceeding generic workplace/theater fragments; named office and body identity still required.
Knicks→Ewing paired with have/need/play dominates roster semantics; need alone is not actual membership. The literary Heather→Mommies pair is separate.
DoubleClick→Internet advertising/company descriptions form the dominant domain family. Geographic Corcoran→Manhattan is not industry membership; generic Internet mention alone is insufficient.

Population-inclusion family is the largest recoverable meaning: explicit include/among paths describe Westerners including Americans. Restaurant co-ownership and Farrakhan ideological leadership are distinct families. The predicate asserts inclusion of some subgroup members, not universal set inclusion; generic include with unclear roles remains ambiguous. Centrally approved narrow extension.

Inverse Senate-to-Republican leadership/majority is the strongest identifiable family, exceeding support three times. A generic Republican may denote an unresolved person or party and cannot automatically establish a named officeholder.

Independent central review finds coaching/program versus competitive encounter/outcome families tied at about four weak/contextual singleton paths, with geography separate. Battle/play does not establish victory; no decisive clear path. All three remain A.
Sports counterpart and series/game context is the largest coherent family; military killing/expulsion and policy are distinct. Preparations do not prove a completed contest.
Explicit wife relation is the largest coherent family, exceeding baseball management; unrelated chief/assistant/manager role is not marriage.
Inverse counsel/lawyer family dominates; sports series and generic discussion/protest remain outside legal representation.
Manager/managerial tenure in WhiteyHerzog→Cardinals is the strongest specific-role family; political front-runner/leader and neighborhood containment remain separate.
Died-at a named hospital overwhelmingly dominates; corporate mogul affiliation is unrelated. Death must be in the named place, with truncated hospital identity explicitly considered.

Sports performance/score comparison supplies four coherent paths, ahead of two explicit political leader/dictator paths and ambiguous generic managing. Declare competitive encounter without requiring victory; metadata-only performance comparisons may remain ambiguous.
Agreement/approval family is strongest; actual reciprocal agreement required, not unilateral approval or a coach merely speaking to a player.

Institutional messages/admonitions/summons/report submission form the largest coherent family, ahead of two side-with support rows. Member-mediated communication and meetings alone retain attachment/actual-message limits.
Research consultancy tracking/reporting subject trends is the largest coherent family, with organization as researcher and Internet as topic; national affiliation or personal travel is separate.
Personal meeting/receiving minister is the largest coherent event family; constitutional grant of power to a legislature is separate and a planned meeting alone does not establish occurrence.

Military invasion is the strongest repeated unambiguously interpretable path (two occurrences). Underspecified go/use/ask/summon or roster-trade fragments cannot support an alternative common action; athlete/coach pairs remain outside the warfare scope.

Five call/promote/recall/summon-from paths form the largest narrow family, ahead of four writing/review paths. Ordered roles are receiving sports team to source affiliate, inspected in Yankees–Class AAA Columbus rows. Omitted player name is acceptable only when recall/promotion context establishes the transferred role; mere bare call-from remains ambiguous.
Both ordered pairs are rivers/creeks and receiving waters; meet/join/flow/empty denotes confluence, not interpersonal meeting. Geographic adjacency alone still needs directed flow evidence.

Explicit speaking-for/spokeswoman of an office is the largest coherent role, ahead of knock and attorney titles. Principal-person versus omitted office and medical-examiner-role identity retain ambiguity.

Constitutional seats/provisions/approval grant is the largest interpretable family, amid political-office and personal challenge/meeting paths. Generic constitutional mention does not by itself confer authority.
Policy-toward is the highest-frequency individually interpretable path (four), tying a dispersed academic-role family. Preserve policy target without assuming diplomatic relations, sale, or combat.

Explicit dismissal-as-manager is the clearest identified office, with task-management/lieutenant context; behind a bench and wearing a number do not automatically supply a manager title. Weak dictionary support is recorded before grades.

Museum-to-street exhibition/address/at-place family is strongest after role inspection, amid inverse minister and executive roles. Incidental event location does not always establish institutional location.

Central adjudication after full dictionary and all ordered rows: government ownership has three clear singleton paths for Cnooc–Chinese, tied with place-of-artist/official/attache for American–Paris. All are singletons and the adjective-country roles further weaken attachment. No prescribed tie-break resolves a dominant coherent family. All cases stay in the denominator as semantic indeterminacy.

Inverse India-to-prime-minister family is the strongest coherent office family; travel to Los Angeles and team trading are separate. Telephone or meeting with another person needs the exact office attachment.
Explicit based/headquarters-in paths dominate and all main arguments are corporations and cities; location of charges alone does not imply base.

Found is the largest interpretable repeated action (three), tied numerically with a role-opaque turn/problem fragment; founding is fixed before any grades, while sports/camp/birth paths remain separate.
Attorney appointments/confirmation/sworn office dominates, with jurisdiction second. Corporate company-of and sporting comparison are unrelated.
Spokesman has four explicit rows, exceeding the three aide rows; consultant is not silently combined with aide to force a tie. Director/professor service is a distinct role.
Attorney representation and counsel-to-client roles consistently dominate; head-of-legal-team is interpreted only with local legal context.
Held/defended title/crown and champion dominates; challenges/promotions for the title alone remain insufficient.
Explicit president-office family is the strongest identifiable title, narrowly exceeding campus location. Generic leader or residence does not become a presidency.
Client X with lawyer Y is the dominant repeated relation, including legal-team membership when established; generic confrontational lead is not enough.
Tell has the highest repeated clear path; topic writing and lawyer attachment families tie only through dispersed/ambiguous fragments. Encounter alone is not necessarily speech.

Artistic performer/company family dominates the full dictionary: dancer, principal, performing, staging and payroll context, with dancer explicit and directing/head adjacent. Choose the narrow professional-dancer predicate rather than expanding to every directing or payroll role. Wife and basketball-management pairs are separate families. Centrally approved occupation scope.
Ownership/reign-as-owner/control/partner context is the strongest coherent family; team leadership or ordinary returning to a team does not establish ownership.
Chair/leadership/reign family is the largest office grouping, ahead of company location. Nomination alone and generic executive require the prior title/actuality conventions.
Fire/dismiss is the largest family (five rows), exceeding replace (four). Manager X removes Y from position; X need not be Y successor.
Leader/president of a named organizational wing/arm dominates; casual White House meeting and intern relationship are separate. Subunit scope remains explicit.

Mixed chair/director office is the largest coherent role family (three), ahead of intern or move-out paths. The incomplete Homeless label and omitted office attachment remain unresolved unless local evidence identifies Y.
Inverse national leader/minister succession family dominates; meeting with a person alone does not show that office.
Institution/venue at an address dominates, with geographic district containment a separate minority. Incidental scheduled event requires institutional location evidence.
Writing/review-in publication is the largest clear family; athlete scoring and coach comments/commitment are separate. Mere quotation is not authorship.

Geographic office/appearance/delivery context dominates institution/person-to-place pairs; Cubs appearance in a sporting event is a distinct nongeographic meaning. Actual presence must still be established.
Spokeswoman description is the largest role family; adviser and inverse national-ruler relations are not folded into it.
Coach title has the greatest dictionary support, ahead of executive succession. Mere consideration as successor or departure is not actual coaching.
Named spokesman/secretary appointment is the largest explicit office family; occupying or ordering guards in the White House does not alone identify a spokesperson.
Follow/join/go-with between House and Senate is the largest cooperative-action family; generic follow/join must still identify shared action, and sequential passage is not automatic cooperation.
Explicit strategist affiliation (six rows) dominates analyst (two) and numeric comparison (three); keep strategist separate from generic analyst.

Central adjudication after full dictionary and all ordered rows: explicit manager titles occur twice for Dave Johnson–Mets and explicit lawyer titles twice for Stephen Jones–McVeigh. All paths are singletons; contextual bringing/using/fighting/attacking/dismissing cannot reliably resolve this tied role mixture. No dominant coherent predicate selected; retain both cases as semantic indeterminacy.
Office/campus location is the consistent family; person-in-city office attachment alone must actually locate X or its own office under the organizational-type rule.
Living/population/ghetto/home family dominates. Generic religious God/heaven and mothers residence may be figurative or indirect, so do not silently supply literal residence.

Being beaten in a named sporting event is the largest coherent path family; it establishes participation when the event and actual contest are clear, not victory. Geographic place and analyst/headquarters fragments stay separate.
Confirmed-as-chairman is the largest repeated office family, ahead of spokesperson and analyst descriptions; confirmation must establish actual office rather than a nominee only.
Explicit president title/candidacy is the largest family; primary victory/candidacy alone is not actual presidency, and corporate national oil affiliation is separate.
